title: Bob McGrew's Arda Raises $230M at $1.5B Valuation for Manufacturing AI
summary:
The former research head of OpenAI is building software agents that automate assembly line programming to streamline industrial production. Arda has raised $230 million in funding, giving the startup a valuation of $1.5 billion, as it develops tools that eliminate the manual coding bottlenecks typically faced by manufacturing engineers.

The AI platform is already being used by defense contractor Anduril to optimize its assembly processes. Bob McGrew, who previously served as OpenAI's Chief Research Officer, stated that the company's tools function for industrial engineers similarly to how agents like Claude or Cursor support programmers, with the ultimate goal of reviving manufacturing in the United States.
